May, a lawyer who broke her own rules to break free from the shackles of her toxic family, finds herself in the dark as an accident takes her sight away. 

In this dark time, she discovers a person who served as a light to guide her and give her courage to face whatever challenges that life may throw her way, because she is no longer fighting alone. 

Radiate the light of love with Film, along with Namtan, on July 18, 2025, 6PM at the UP Theater for NAMTAN FILM 1ST FAN MEETING IN MANILA.
